RagShortTexts: Woods, rivers and warnings help foot fighters avoid cavalry advantages.
Pursuit lengthens supply, messages and routes home.

Variants.Content: Banks, woods and warnings help foot fighters avoid cavalry advantages. Pursuit lengthens supply and messages; people who know exits help fighters return.

Woods, rivers and warnings help foot fighters avoid cavalry advantages. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Pursuit lengthens supply, messages and routes home.

Pursuit lengthens supply, messages and routes home. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Woods, rivers and warnings help foot fighters avoid cavalry advantages.

Woods, rivers and warnings help foot fighters avoid cavalry advantages. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Pursuit lengthens supply, messages and routes home.
